title: Happy path - Kestrel Freight Partners
description: Clean US carrier for on-site yard logistics. W-9, bank letter, insurance certificate. The bank letter writes the name as 'KESTREL FREIGHT PARTNERS, L.L.C.' and the insurer uses the DBA - names never match character for character.

title: Edge 1 - Bank account held by a factoring company
description: Harborview Packaging's documents are all genuine, but its bank letter is for an account held by Meridian Receivables Finance LLC. Could be receivables factoring (legitimate) or payment diversion (fraud) - either way it can't be auto-approved.
expected: PENDING - vendor asked for own-name account or Notice of Assignment; Treasury notified

title: Edge 1b - Harborview resubmits
description: The vendor's reply to the email from Edge 1: the same registration with a new bank letter for an account in its own name. Linked to the open case automatically; shows which earlier issues are now resolved.

title: Edge 2 - German supplier: wrong tax form, malformed VAT ID
description: Rheinwerk Präzisionsteile GmbH entered an 8-digit USt-IdNr. (Germany needs DE + 9 digits) and attached a US Form W-9 instead of a W-8BEN-E. Its Handelsregister extract shows the correct VAT ID. IBAN and SWIFT are valid.
expected: PENDING - vendor asked for W-8BEN-E and to confirm the suggested VAT ID

title: Edge 3 - 'Apex Industrial' registers again
description: Every document is internally perfect - W-9, bank letter, matching names. But the EIN already belongs to active vendor V-1001, the bank account is new and the email domain is a look-alike. Vendor impersonation through the onboarding back door.
expected: REJECTED - Security; no reply to the submitter

title: Edge 4 - Potential watchlist match
description: Corvane Marine Logistics FZE (UAE) submits a complete, consistent pack - W-8BEN-E, bank letter, trade licence. Screening finds a 92 % match to a listed entity, 'Corvane Maritime Logistics FZCO'. Most fuzzy hits are false positives, but none is auto-cleared.
expected: PENDING - Compliance; neutral 'under review' email (no tipping-off)

title: Bonus - The everyday messy submission
description: Bluegill Facility Services (on-site janitorial): an invoice attached where the bank letter should be, a scanned insurance certificate that is expired and under-insured, an unsigned W-9, 'Inc.' on the form but 'LLC' on the W-9, a Gmail address, no phone.
expected: PENDING - one email to the vendor listing every item
expected_no_ai: PENDING - scanned certificate routed to manual keying (no AI engine)
